collection.title: VW Golf Estate 2012 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Estate 2012 - 2019 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Golf Estate, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
